briefings.engineering: Credential stuffing: 48,300 failed logins/min. Three sources carry 80% of the attack; the rest is a rotating botnet at ~200 attempts/min per IP. Real-user success 89.5%, p95 1080 ms.
briefings.support: Some customers see slow or failed logins. Tell them there is no evidence of account compromise yet, and recommend a password reset if they reused their password elsewhere.
briefings.commander: SEV-2 security incident on auth-api. Team: Sam, Jordan. A rate limit plus blocklist is being sandbox-tested. Your decision: approve the security controls.
briefings.leadership: An automated login attack is degrading sign-in for real users (10% failing). No confirmed data breach; protective controls are being deployed.
